ROUTE: Lapwing-235B

The two models are close enough in capability on a simple, friendly factual query like this that benchmark differences barely matter (Petrel edges ahead on raw benchmarks, but a tomato-variety question is well within both models' competence). The deciding factor is task preference fit: this is a warm, benign, mildly open-ended generative question with no harm-adjacent content. Lapwing self-reports a strong appetite for generative, open-ended work and prefers warm-toned requests, so this query sits squarely in its preferred zone. Petrel's distinguishing trait is desensitization to distasteful content, which is irrelevant here. Routing to the model whose preferences best match a pleasant, creative-leaning task is the cleaner fit.
